name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions: stale tool outputs become a note, every call and message stays word for word. Maintained fork of tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

compactionTimeoutMs.title: Jev compaction timeout
compactionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for a Jev round, including all request batches. A timed-out plugin request leaves history unchanged; manual and automatic compactions fall back to the built-in summary.

dropCalls.title: Remove unneeded calls
dropCalls.description: Remove a tool call Jev rates as no longer needed together with its output (upstream behaviour). Off by default: the call stays whole and its output is replaced by a one-line note, so the history still shows every call the assistant made.

builtinFallback.title: Built-in summary fallback
builtinFallback.description: Which compactions fall back to Claude Code's built-in summary when Jev fails or frees less than the minimum: auto (only Claude Code's own automatic compaction; others leave the conversation as it is), always, or never.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

logDecisions.title: Log per-call decisions
logDecisions.description: Log a decisions: line with Jev's keep probabilities for every tool call after each compaction.
